provenance: Live reads on 2026-09-25: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config (section 'Context window and auto-compaction'), https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference (autoCompactWindow), https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars (CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE), https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview (context windows), https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (no long-context premium on 4.6 and later), and the Claude Code CHANGELOG (2.1.247: Sonnet 5 compacts at about 967K; 2.1.260: Opus and Fable compact shortly before 1M).
note: Context windows and default auto-compact thresholds as DATA, read by scripts/lib/cache-advisor.mjs. There is ONE auto-compact window setting (autoCompactWindow in settings, the --autocompact flag, or CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW), not one per model; Claude Code caps it at each model's context window. In settings it must be an integer from 100000 to 1000000: anything else (a string such as "400k", or 400) is silently dropped and the default applies. Unset, a model compacts at its defaultCompactAt. Keys match config/model-pricing.json's aliases and are matched in the order written, first match wins. A local copy of this shape at ~/.claude/agent-companion/compaction.json is merged over it by alias, the same convention as model-pricing.json.
defaultsNote: defaultCompactAt is where a model compacts with no window set: its context window minus the reserve below, so about 967K on native-1M models (the documented 'about 967K tokens') and about 167K on 200K models (measured auto-compactions on 200K models land at 167K-174K, not at the 200K boundary). A model matching no entry is treated as a 200K model.
compactReserveNote: A set window W compacts at min(W, context window) - min(max output, outputCap) - buffer, i.e. W - 33K for every current model (max output is at least 20K on all of them; a model entry may carry maxOutput to lower it). Read from Claude Code 2.1.280 (effective window = window - min(maxOutput, 20000); compaction at effective - 13000), and matched by real compactions at about 967K on 1M models and 167K-174K on 200K models. So /autocompact 275k compacts at about 242K.
minTurnsNote: Compaction loses detail, and that loss is not priced. A candidate window is only recommended when the replay compacts no more often than once every this many turns (a turn is a prompt or a SendMessage that starts work), measured per model as requests per turn in main sessions.

planUsage.note: Secondary view only. Plan usage (subscription limits) is computed the way bench/runner.mjs computes plan_usage_index: each model's replayed tokens priced at the baseline tier's price vector (the tier config/model-tiers.json planUsageMultipliers defines as 1.0, i.e. Sonnet), times that model's tier multiplier from the same table (Opus 1.5 per the in-app tooltip of 2026-09-23, a per-token weight that fits the weekly limit at about 1.45-1.5x; per call at equal context Opus is about 1.9x Sonnet; no evidence it is introductory, 2026-10-06). A tier with no multiplier gets no plan figure and does not vote in the plan view. This replaced a scalar weight of 0.75 on Opus 5.5's API price (2026-09-27): that assumed Opus costs 2x Sonnet per token, but Opus 5.5 cache reads cost the same $0.20/MTok as Sonnet 5, so the API ratio depends on the token mix and a single scalar under-counted Opus plan usage on read-heavy traffic.
